visual_review.identity: Dark cool charcoal/slate-gray polygon stone paving with narrow brown-gray joints and medium infill; a few subtle broad fractures on main stones. Original dark floor identity retained, no forge objects, glow or wet sheen.
visual_review.detail_density: Approximately 5-7 main stones across the image, fewer and larger than the requested 8-12. Medium joint infill is quite abundant and some small chips remain.
visual_review.scale_caveat: Main stone widths are approximately 30-70 world units at a 256-unit full-source period, with occasional larger faces. Initial world period is a parent preview parameter, not an accepted gameplay scale.
visual_review.style_caveat: Broad quiet face planes and low-contrast dark palette. Residual fine face texture and a few ragged plane edges remain; no programmatic cleanup.
visual_review.native_acceptance: 1254 fully opaque native, material identity retained. Active tone 0 source candidate for c01-14; not a scene binding or seamlessness pass.

reference_material_identity: Cool dark charcoal/slate-blue irregular polygon paving stones, many somewhat angular and worn, with a few broad face fractures and smaller stones tightly infilling narrow dark joints. Paved continuous floor, not loose scree, metal, lava or glowing ore.
period_status: candidate parent integration parameter, not bound by this source handoff
